Darwin and his girlfriend Christine get into an angry fight one night. The next day she is found dead in a dumpster. Darwin is accused of the crime. But what really happened? It could be only his shadow knows the truth.

In a collapsing near-future U.S., brilliant high-school senior Elliot Vreeland's search for his famous missing economist father and family puts him between an out-of-control federal government and a revolutionary anarchist underground. Starring Kevin Sorbo, Christian Kramme and Reid Cox.
A doctor must follow the instructions on a drug dealer's beeper to rescue his kidnapped son. Starring Harvey Keitel, Joey Lauren Adams, Ed Quinn.

Drinking to excess and barely holding down his job as a teacher, he's a man lost with nothing to live for. Pol is a teenager with a seemingly calm life. He lives with his brother, and is still in high school. However, Pol has a secret: Deerhoof, a cuddly teddy bear who thinks, moves around, and with whom he shares his best moments. Life goes on as normal until the arrival of Ikari, an enigmatic student who seems to be hiding something.
The dead feast on human flesh and stop at nothing for it. The living, confined to the dark corners of the world, must do what it takes to survive.

Marisa, a 20-year-old German girl, hates foreigners, Jews, cops, and everyone she finds guilty for the decline of her country. She provokes, drinks, fights and her next tattoo will be a portrait of Adolf Hitler.
In this fish out of water tale, a traditional Indian house wife, visits her successful son in the USA but this simple mother cannot cope with the modern ways and soon finds herself in trouble.
